description: This file defines an abstract class 'Spillable' used in Apache Spark to manage in-memory collections that can be spilled to disk when memory thresholds are exceeded. It includes methods for spilling, force spilling, tracking memory usage, and logging spill events.

classes.name: Spillable
classes.description: An abstract class managing in-memory collections with spill-to-disk capability in Spark.

methods.name: spill
methods.description: Abstract method to spill the collection to disk.

methods.name: forceSpill
methods.description: Abstract method to force spilling of the collection.

methods.name: addElementsRead
methods.description: Increments the count of elements read since last spill.

methods.name: maybeSpill
methods.description: Decides whether to spill based on element count or memory size, and performs spill if needed.

methods.name: spill
methods.description: Overrides MemoryConsumer.spill; spills data to free memory when required.

methods.name: releaseMemory
methods.description: Releases allocated memory back to the pool.
